_readme_1: HOW TO ADD A NEW LANGUAGE: Add the 2-letter code to the 'languages' list below.
_readme_2: HOW TO ADD A NEW COLUMN: Add the exact column name to the 'template_cols' list.
_readme_3: IMPORTANT: The order of columns in 'template_cols' is EXACTLY how they will appear in the generated Excel file from left to right. Do not break the formatting (make sure quotes and commas are correct).
_readme_4: HOW TO CHANGE DATA MAPPING: The 'mapping' section links your final output columns (left) to the raw Excel columns (right). If your raw Excel file changes a column name, update the right side here.
